summary: Backend-only regression for Section 16 prompt-caching wiring (LLM_PROMPT_CACHING_ENABLED=0 default). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_prompt_caching_regression.py — 6/6 tests PASS live against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Confirmed: (a) normal single-turn chat 200 (iters=1, cache_system=False branch — reply 'done'), (b) multi-iteration tool-loop chat 200 with orchestrator reaching iter=2/N (log evidence 'R10_TIMING llm_call iter=2/3' etc, provider=glm-5.2 & deepseek-v3-council-c, no tracebacks), (c) 3 sequential ordinary chat turns all 200, (d) no Python tracebacks / UnboundLocalError in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log during or after the run. Flag default-off wiring does not regress normal chat.

minor.issue: Could NOT reproduce the documented pre-existing max_tool_iters=0 UnboundLocalError with prompt 'Say hi.' — request short-circuited via intent-gateway-casual (provider='intent-gateway-casual') and returned 200 before reaching the buggy code path in orchestrator.py:~3265. This is not a regression of the current fix; it just means the repro prompt needs to be one that actually enters the tool-loop path (e.g. a coding/tool-requiring prompt) before max_tool_iters=0 will bite. Main agent's separate git-stash repro remains authoritative — recorded as pre-existing LOW-priority not tied to this fix.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: if desired, tighten the max_tool_iters=0 pre-existing bug repro test by using a tool-requiring prompt (e.g. 'read a file X') so the request actually enters the buggy loop path instead of being absorbed by intent-gateway-casual.
critical_code_review_comments: openrouter_client.py: guard `_caching_enabled = os.getenv('LLM_PROMPT_CACHING_ENABLED','0')=='1'` is correctly checked BEFORE reading the ContextVar hint — flag-off path is truly inert, byte-identical for non-Claude/no-opt-in callers. Good.

_state.py: `get_prompt_cache_context()` returns a safe default dict `{session_id:None, cache_system:False}` when unset — no KeyError risk in callers. Async ContextManager `prompt_cache_context` uses ContextVar tokens correctly (reset in finally-ish semantics via async CM).

orchestrator.py: opt-in `cache_system=(iters>=2)` is defensible — the system prompt is only guaranteed byte-identical from iter 2 onward, so this avoids invalidating a cache on iter 1 when SP composition may still vary. Good.

councils.py / ceo.py: unconditional opt-in is fine because Council persona SP is a fixed constant per member. Verify (out of scope for this pass) that ceo.py's rescue path doesn't accidentally mutate the SP mid-session — a future test could hash the SP across iterations to prove invariance.
openrouter_providers.py::_call_deepseek: session_id passthrough is scoped inside `if os.getenv('LLM_PROMPT_CACHING_ENABLED','0')=='1'` so default-off path is byte-identical payload. Good.

Env: `LLM_PROMPT_CACHING_ENABLED=0` present and set to 0 as advertised. Both `LLM_MODEL` lines (14 and 86) exist in backend/.env — the second one (`qwen3.8-27b`) overwrites the first at load time; unrelated to this fix but worth cleaning up in a future pass.
